sourceContract: Gemini CLI command hook protocol (AfterModel), non-final streaming chunk carrying a cumulative usageMetadata snapshot
author: otel-hook integration owner (agent)
sanitization: Prompt and response text are invented single sentences; token counts are invented figures; the session id and repository root are synthetic placeholders.
notes: Pairs with after-model.json to pin the streaming contract: AfterModel fires per chunk and more than one chunk may carry usageMetadata. The counts are a snapshot of the response so far (512/40/552, then 512/136/648), so the two chunks together must be billed 512 input once, not 1024.
